problem: Consider a spherical planet with radius $(5\times {10}^{8})\,\text{m}$ and surface gravitational acceleration $g=9\,{\text{m/s}}^{2}.$ Which equation best models the velocity $v$ of an object projected radially outward from the planet's surface with an initial velocity of $(1.2\times {10}^{5})\,\text{m/s},$ where $r$ is the distance from the planet's center to the object. Assume the only force acting on the object is the force due to gravity.

activity_context.topic_title: Modeling Escape Velocity With First-Order ODEs
